title: Truckers of Europe 3: big update and multiplayer on the way
text: Wanda Software says multiplayer development is complete and the public release is almost ready. The next update adds the IVECO S-Way truck, driver hiring and job management, a new world map with navigation between any two cities, character customization, and multiplayer rooms to play and take jobs with friends. After it come a new DAF truck, a Volvo interior update, and the map expansion.

title: Multiplayer convoys are coming
text: Multiplayer is still in testing. We will post the first convoy dates here and on Discord as soon as testing ends.

title: The new Apex Transporte site is live
text: Check the job log, the leaderboard, the gallery and the promotion ladder. Numbers update on their own.
